grids.rule: One construction cell equals a 2x2 block of Romestead-style terrain subtiles. Visual sprites may extend above the footprint but collision and placement remain on the 32 px construction grid.

floor_basic.notes: Four seamless 16x16 variants in a 2x2 sheet. Runtime fills each 32x32 build cell with four deterministic subtiles, so repetition is broken without extra painting work.

wall_horizontal.notes: Base raised wall skin. 64 px visual height matches the approximately 61 px Juno standing silhouette. Renderer tiles/stretches the middle across contiguous runs instead of placing visible blocks cell by cell.

wall_vertical.notes: Separate authored perspective/light treatment. Do not rotate the horizontal art for final-quality visuals.

wall_joint_post.notes: One reusable post/joint hides corners, T junctions, crosses and exposed run ends. It is placed by code, not selected by the player.

stairs_north_south.notes: A one-cell-wide, two-cell-long flight is wide enough for the 25.5 px Juno silhouette without making stairs consume an entire room.

stairs_east_west.notes: Authored separately for lighting/perspective even though the gameplay footprint is a 90-degree rotation of the north/south flight.

door_threshold_optional.notes: Optional polish layer. No collision. Bridges indoor floor and exterior terrain visually.

run_rendering.horizontal: Merge contiguous east-west wall-family cells into one repeated/tiled horizontal strip.
run_rendering.vertical: Merge contiguous north-south wall-family cells into one repeated/tiled vertical strip.
run_rendering.junctions: Overlay wall_joint_post where horizontal and vertical runs meet and at visually exposed endpoints.
run_rendering.special_segments: Window and doorway cells split the run locally and insert their orientation-specific 32x64 module.

special_segment_rules.window: Must belong to a straight wall axis. Corner/T/cross placement is rejected or normalized back to a regular wall.
special_segment_rules.doorway: Must belong to a straight wall axis. Door leaf is an attachment/runtime component of the doorway, not free-floating architecture.
special_segment_rules.door: Opening state changes leaf collision/navigation only. The structural doorway remains part of the wall network.

interior_readability.rule: When the player is inside a detected room, wall segments between the camera and player fade or collapse to a 16 px base silhouette. Full collision remains unchanged.
interior_readability.future_roof: Roof should be generated from detected room coverage rather than placed tile by tile. Roof hides/fades as one room group.

runtime_implications: Save orientation, material skin, wall-family subtype and attachment state per construction cell.
Rebuild only dirty wall runs after placement/removal instead of rebuilding all walls.
Door state must update collision and navigation occupancy.
Closed wall loops create semantic indoor regions used by weather occlusion, wildlife spawn exclusion, interior lighting and future roof generation.
Upper-floor surfaces continue using the existing MultiFloorBuildManager, but stairs migrate from one cell to an oriented 1x2/2x1 footprint.
Build preview shows the final auto-connected appearance and inferred orientation before payment/placement.

romestead_visual_references.design_takeaway: Romestead architecture is strongly modular. Oathwake keeps that compositional principle but reduces the number of authored combinations by moving topology assembly into code.
